headline: United's price per gallon follows Gulf Coast spot jet fuel with a lag of about 18 days: price paid = $0.14 + 1.05 x spot (90% range for the slope 1.02 to 1.07; 16 quarters, 2018Q1 to 2023Q4), off by 3 cents a gallon on average in those years and by 9 cents in the 10 quarters of 2024-2026 it never saw.
plain_summary: United's price per gallon follows Gulf Coast spot jet fuel with a lag of about 18 days: price paid = $0.14 + 1.05 x spot (90% range for the slope 1.02 to 1.07; 16 quarters, 2018Q1 to 2023Q4), off by 3 cents a gallon on average in those years and by 9 cents in the 10 quarters of 2024-2026 it never saw. Same fit on 2013Q1 to 2016Q4 against 2018Q1 to 2023Q4: the lag went from 28 to 18 days, the basis from $0.39 to $0.14, the slope from 0.94 to 1.05 and the typical miss from 6 cents to 4 cents: the relationship tightened after the early, hedged years. In 2024-2026 the reported price was above the prediction in 10 of 10 quarters (the prediction ran 9 cents low on average) and inside the P10-P90 range in 3 of 10: the range is too narrow. For 2026Q3 the predicted price paid is $3.86 a gallon (P10 $3.79, P90 $3.93), with the quarter's fuel prices complete; management assumed about $3.69, which is below the range. On 2026-07-14, the date of the forward curve behind that figure, the same method gave $3.63 (P10 $3.24, P90 $4.15). Refit that also learns from the 2024-2026 reports: $3.93 (P10 $3.82, P90 $4.04), management's figure below the range. Fit that keeps the hedged years: $3.77 (P10 $3.64, P90 $3.90), management's figure inside the range. Delta check: with Delta's own basis the method gives $3.55 (P10 $3.40, P90 $3.70) for the September quarter; Delta reported $3.61, inside the range, against the $3.15 it assumed in July (method off by 6 cents, the assumption by 46 cents). Management's $575 million over 1,219 to 1,233 million gallons implies a price change of about $0.47 a gallon; tax alone at 21.9% gives $1.38 a share, not $1.12, and with the 21.9% tax rate and the stated profit-sharing tiers (18.9%) it comes to $1.12. Spot moved $0.80 between 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-14, so the implied move is 59% of the spot move: a gap, not a match (this module's own estimate of the quarter's price moved $0.59).

fit.equation: reported price per gallon = a + b0 x mean spot over the quarter + b1 x mean spot over the quarter's window moved back 30 days

selection.rule: Specification: the candidate with the lower mean absolute error on the select years when estimated on the fit years. Estimation window: the start year with the lower one-quarter-ahead error walking forward through the select years. Pandemic quarters are left out of both.

tax.definition: 1 - net income / income before income taxes, GAAP, summed over the quarters listed

profit_sharing.caveat: Read from the notes field of the literature entry, which paraphrases the investor update; not a machine-verified quote. Assumes every tier applies at the margin.

price_move.note: United marks the quarter's average on the forward curve, which this project does not hold; the spot series is a single day's price. A spot jump moves a quarter average by less when the forward curve prices later months below spot.

limits: In 2024-2026 the frozen relationships ran 9 cents low for United and 9 cents low for Delta on average: what the airlines pay over Gulf Coast spot has moved since 2018-2023, and the frozen coefficients do not know it. United's P10-P90 range held the reported price in 30% of 10 test quarters.
One price index: Gulf Coast spot. United buys at many airports, with regional differentials, taxes and into-plane fees; the basis is their average over the estimation years and misses when they move.

The lag is inferred from quarterly averages alone (16 quarters); daily purchases are not observed. The lag is a mix of the quarter and the quarter moved back 30 days, so it cannot exceed about a month by much.
The predictive range assumes spot follows a random walk for the remaining days and ignores the forward curve that management guides on.
Coefficients are frozen at the end of 2023. If United resumes hedging, or its mix of purchase locations changes, the relationship changes.
Pandemic quarters (2020Q1 to 2021Q4) are left out of estimation and of the headline errors; their errors are in `reported`.
The estimation window was chosen by walk-forward error on 8 select quarters; with pandemic quarters kept the result is in variants_tried and need not agree.
Delta's adjusted price includes its refinery's result, which moves with refining margins; its basis is less stable than United's.
The reconciliation of management's per-share figure uses a GAAP effective tax rate and profit-sharing tiers taken from a paraphrase in literature.json; United does not publish the calculation.
